ac_cloud-sheets.first_test: STALE UNTIL 2026-09-11, and worth saying why: this read 'assert upstream.sha256 is 64 hex characters and source_identity.mode is pin', naming two keys 05b0c6c15 deliberately DELETED when the app stopped being a mirror. Cloud Office is a source build now, and its testers are network-bound by nature — every claim it makes is about a REMOTE object (a pinned Gerrit revision, a pinned upstream APK), so it cannot honestly offer the no-network check the note above asks for. First test: tests/test-configure-flags-exist.sh — every --with-* in upstream.online.configure is a real AC_ARG_WITH at the pinned revision, and the flag upstream actually derives applicationId from is the one we pass, carrying android.application_id. It caught --with-android-package-name, which exists nowhere upstream and which autoconf would have warned about and ignored, shipping the megabuild as org.collabora.app. NOT COVERED: nothing compiles this app, so no tester proves the patch series BUILDS — tests/patches-apply.sh proves only that it applies, and is deliberately not a test-*.sh because it costs a 471 MB fetch.
